title: A Survey on Semantic Modeling for Building Energy Management
abstract: arXiv:2404.11716v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Building Energy Management (BEM) is central to reducing energy use and CO2 emissions in the building sector. Although IoT technologies now provide extensive operational data, heterogeneous data models, device descriptions, and contextual representations continue to limit semantic interoperability, limiting the development of generalisable, autonomous, context-aware BEM applications. Ontologies address this challenge by providing structured, machine-interpretable representations of building data, systems, and operational context. This survey examines semantic modelling for BEM during the building operational phase. It reviews 60 semantic models and analyses more than 20 ontology-based BEM use cases. It further quantifies Ontology Instantiation Rates (OIR) and missing concepts across those use cases. translated_title: 建筑能源管理语义建模综述
translated_abstract: 建筑能源管理（BEM）是减少建筑行业能源消耗和二氧化碳排放的核心。尽管物联网技术现已能够提供大量的运行数据，但异构的数据模型、设备描述和上下文表示仍然限制了语义互操作性，从而制约了可泛化、自主、具备上下文感知能力的建筑能源管理应用的发展。本体通过提供结构化、机器可解释的建筑数据、系统和运行上下文表示，来应对这一挑战。本综述考察了建筑运行阶段的建筑能源管理语义建模，回顾了60个语义模型，并分析了20多个基于本体的建筑能源管理用例，还进一步量化了这些用例中的本体实例化率（OIR）和缺失概念。为支持基于证据的本体使用评估，我们引入了本体证据完整性（OEC）的概念，这是一种衡量……的度量（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该综述系统回顾了建筑运行阶段的建筑能源管理语义建模，分析了60个语义模型和20多个基于本体的用例，并创新性地提出本体证据完整性（OEC）这一新指标，以支持对本体使用的基于证据的评估。
en_tdlr: This survey reviews 60 semantic models and over 20 ontology-based BEM use cases, and introduces the novel notion of Ontology Evidence Completeness (OEC) to support evidence-based assessment of ontology use in building energy management.
